description: Kyoko always thought she would end up getting married to her long-term boyfriend Kenichi. However, reality hits her like a ton of bricks when he decides to end their relationship and move to Kyushu without her. At the age of 24, she starts a new life in Tokyo, where she crosses paths with Yoichi at her workplace. His warmth tugs at her heart, and despite their 17-year age gap, she falls in love with him. However, fate has other plans, and when two other men shake up her love life, she must make the biggest decision of her life.

description: Yuto, a high schooler, gets a new drone and decides to test it out by recording himself swatting centipedes in his kitchen. Little does he know, his house has mysteriously turned into a dungeon, and those "pests" are actually rare monsters! Due to a drone setting mishap, his video gets streamed globally, causing quite a stir.The dungeon's magic brings the drone to life, giving it consciousness and a name: Kuro. To prevent an all-out war over Yuto, a team from the Dungeon Corporation sets up shop next door. Meanwhile, Yuto remains completely unaware of the commotion he's caused and keeps up his daily bug-squashing routine.

"In the face of justice, there are no taboos that should not be violated."

In the near future, humanity is in the depths of fear due to the onslaught of monsters. To protect world peace, the united Cross Rangers will enforce justice today! ...Or so it was supposed to be. Cross Red, also known as Akama Retsuo, is a man who is passionate about justice. With an overflowing sense of justice, he commits a taboo one night with Cross Pink. description: I logged into the hottest new VR game— and got handed… a shovel? Not a sword. Not magic. Just… a shovel. Apparently, it can build anything—walls, weapons, traps— but there’s a catch: every monster in the game targets only me. So what do I do? I dig, I build, and when they come at me… I smash everything with my shovel! But now, some strange folks have shown up, drawn by the chaos I’ve caused with my one-of-a-kind weapon. It’s me and my shovel vs the whole world. Bring it on.

description: In this world there are 5 different races: Angels, Demons, Beastkin, Vampires, and Humans. Among them, Elle, an angel boasting immense power, belongs to the Angel Police. Having a strong sense of Justice in her heart, she is strict with both herself and others and diligently carries out her duties. One day, Elle, because she is a member of the Angel Police Elite Force, is ordered to capture the timid demon Eve. Elle ends up chasing Eve who is a bit of a problem child who manages to escape from prison every time she is caught! Moreover, both Eve's ability to swiftly escape and her strong summon beasts make it quite difficult for her to be captured! While she is chasing Eve, she gets caught up in an outrageous incident!!

description:
It’s red, hot, and burning with flames! Sage is a young boy from a small village who dreams of becoming a renowned Piece Maker like Edmond Dantes. But when his antics to help others with crafting skills get him in trouble with the local mercenary gang, a trio of rowdy blacksmiths who call themselves the Red Pepper Guild show up and come to his aid. He joins the Red Pepper Guild in their quest to solve the mystery of strange dungeons and mana stones, but can he survive the battles and the blazing dishes his eccentric guild master cooks up?
